SOUL_STORM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
For each [gold]Soul[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], add a [gold]Soul[/gold] to your {IfUpgraded:show:draw|discard} pile.
DEVOUR_LIFE.description: At the start of your turn, ALL enemies lose 1 HP. Add a [gold]Soul[/gold] to your {IfUpgraded:show:draw|discard} pile for each enemy.
SHROUD.title: Raiment of Doom
NEGATIVE_PULSE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {DiyDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to ALL enemies. Apply {DiySelfDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
DEATHBRINGER.description: Apply {DiyDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. Apply {DiySelfDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
END_OF_DAYS.description:
Apply {DiyDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Kill enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP. Apply {DiySelfDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
BLIGHT_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals additional damage equal to half your [gold]Doom[/gold], rounded down.
NO_ESCAPE.description: Start with {CalculationBase:diff()}, plus {CalculationExtra:diff()} for every {DoomThreshold:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] on the enemy. Apply 150% of the result as [gold]Doom[/gold], rounded down. Apply {DiySelfDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
COUNTDOWN.description: At the start of your turn, apply {DiyDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to a random enemy and {DiySelfDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
OBLIVION.description: Whenever you play a card this turn, apply {DiyDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to the enemy and {DiySelfDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
REAPER_FORM.description:
Whenever your Attacks deal damage, apply [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to 150% of damage dealt to the enemy and one third to yourself. Round down.
You cannot die to [gold]Doom[/gold].
STS2DIY_CARD_DEATH_LIFE_PACT_CARD.title: Death and Life's Pact
STS2DIY_CARD_DEATH_LIFE_PACT_CARD.descri: This turn, whenever you deal damage, [gold]Summon[/gold] 2. Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] deals damage, gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
STS2DIY_CARD_NEGATIVE_ENERGY_ABSORPTION_: Absorb half of an enemy's [gold]Doom[/gold]. Gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
STS2DIY_CARD_SHARED_DOOM_CARD.title: Together Unto Death
STS2DIY_CARD_SHARED_DOOM_CARD.descriptio:
Double your [gold]Doom[/gold]. At the start of your next turn, transfer all your [gold]Doom[/gold] to all enemies.{IfUpgraded:show:
You cannot die to [gold]Doom[/gold] this turn.}
STS2DIY_CARD_BITTER_HATRED_CARD.title: Endless Hatred
STS2DIY_CARD_BITTER_HATRED_CARD.descript:
After [gold]Osty[/gold] dies, it deals {BitterHatredPower:diff()}% more damage starting next turn. (Stacks multiplicatively.)
If Osty goes a turn without dying, reset the damage bonus.
STS2DIY_CARD_BLOOD_OATH_CARD.title: Blood Oath
STS2DIY_CARD_BLOOD_OATH_CARD.description:
Lose HP equal to your [gold]Doom[/gold]. Gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
At the end of combat, recover the HP lost this way.
STS2DIY_CARD_DARK_RITUAL_CARD.title: Dark Ritual
STS2DIY_CARD_DARK_RITUAL_CARD.descriptio: At the start of your turn, lose 1 Max HP and [gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
STS2DIY_CARD_POISONED_DRAUGHT_CARD.title: Poisoned Draught
STS2DIY_CARD_BORROWED_BODY_CARD.title: Borrowed Body
STS2DIY_CARD_BORROWED_BODY_CARD.descript:
Can only be played if your [gold]Doom[/gold] is at least your current HP.
Transfer all your [gold]Doom[/gold] to ALL enemies. Gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold].
STS2DIY_CARD_SHARED_VENGEANCE_CARD.title: Shared Vengeance
STS2DIY_CARD_SHARED_VENGEANCE_CARD.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] dies, this card costs 1 less [gold]Energy[/gold] this combat.
STS2DIY_CARD_NEGATIVE_ENERGY_INFUSION_CA:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times}.
Hits an additional time for each creature with [gold]Doom[/gold].
STS2DIY_CARD_VOID_PASSAGE_CARD.title: Void Passage
STS2DIY_CARD_VOID_PASSAGE_CARD.descripti:
Give all cards in your hand [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
For each card that gains [gold]Ethereal[/gold] this way, [gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
STS2DIY_CARD_PARTNER_CARD.title: Partner
STS2DIY_CARD_PARTNER_CARD.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] fully absorbs the next attack hit against you. You cannot [gold]Summon[/gold] for the next {Turns:diff()} turns.
Requires a living [gold]Osty[/gold].
STS2DIY_CARD_SOUL_PHANTOM_CARD.title: Soul Phantom
STS2DIY_CARD_SOUL_PHANTOM_CARD.descripti:
{IfUpgraded:show:Upgrade ALL your [gold]Souls[/gold] this combat.
}Whenever you play a [gold]Soul[/gold], you may choose a card in your draw pile. It gains [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
